title: UW Fragment Frontmatter 1.0
description: Frontmatter of a `.uwpart.md` fragment — one section's content held outside the record that references it (UW Composition 1.0, RFC 0021). This schema covers the YAML frontmatter object only; the fragment's blocks are ordinary UW blocks and validate against `uwmd-block.schema.json` plus their section's own schema. A fragment is NOT an underwriting record: validating against this schema establishes that the fragment is identifiable and independently reviewable, and establishes nothing about whether the section it carries is complete or correct.

uwpart_version.description: Fragment format version. `1.0` for this specification.

part_id.description: Stable identity of this fragment, unique within its package. Named by the referencing record's `external.parts` array; a duplicate id makes resolution ambiguous and is refused.

section.description: The single section every block in this fragment targets. Standard sections use the IDs registered in UW_FORMAT_SPEC_v1.md §4; extension sections MUST start with 'x_'. A fragment carrying a block for any other section is refused (`COMP-SECTION-MISMATCH`) — contributing to two sections is what two fragments are for.

collection_member.description: `true` marks this fragment as one row of a collection section, merged with its siblings under the referencing directive's `collection_key`. Absent or `false` means this fragment supplies the whole section, in which case exactly one fragment may do so.

deal_id.description: MUST NOT be present. A fragment is not an underwriting record, and carrying a deal identifier is the cheapest way for one to be presented as a deal. Refused as `COMP-PART-MALFORMED` rather than warned about.
